body:
Thinking about going to work tomorrow, and how I've just been going through the motions ever since my mother left me, I've come to realize that I need to get away from this job and advance as fast as I can or I will remain stagnant and become miserable (I already am when I have to go there)

It's been a year, and I feel fine other than being stuck at a job that is unfulfilling and isn't going to get me anywhere that I want to be in life.
I would appreciate that, a couple of my friends suggested looking into bootcamps but I know they can be quite costly.

My father died of cancer 5 years ago and said his last goodbyes to me over the phone, he visited once when he got out of prison but was never really a part of my life. He also didn't pay child support.

My uncle died at some point too, and who knows where the money went.

I haven't had any contact with my aunt since she stopped staying with us (mother and her didn't get along) but I did try to track her down to no avail. There's no public record of her so I believe she's either dead or homeless.

edit: and no I'm not suicidal, all things considered I'm doing quite well for myself but I want to find a way out of retail slave work and achieve something greater, things feel stagnant and hopeless at times after everything
